_comment: Illustrative example for schema documentation only. All numbers, dates and claims are placeholders, not real data or research.
thesis: Public signals are mixed: news tone centers on weight-loss drugs and sugar taxes, while hiring and employee sentiment look stable. The unresolved transfer-pricing tax case is the one item others must address.

strengths.point: Hiring activity and employee review scores are steady.

risks.point: A long-running tax dispute could bring a sizable cash payment.

invalidation_rationale: Signals are qualitative; a resolution of the tax case would change the read.
conviction_reason: Signals point in different directions with no clear trend.
self_evidence_reason: News and review sites sampled; no consumer complaint data applies.
missing_data: Consumer complaint data (CFPB not applicable to beverages)

red_flags.flag: Transfer-pricing tax litigation outcome could require a large cash payment.
New sugar-tax proposals in several markets.

signals.signal: News coverage links GLP-1 drug adoption to softer soda demand.
Open roles in bottling partnerships and marketing hold steady.
Employee review ratings are flat year over year.
